data.exact_reserve_text: The GAAP calendar year result reflects the application of a prudent reserving policy, the outcome of a full reserving review of the Syndicate 3330 book of business and reserve strengthening in certain classes, in particular non-marine liability construction.

prior_year_events.event_name: Reinsurance to Close (RITC) of Syndicate 1969 and Syndicate 3330 liabilities
prior_year_events.impact_description: Initial booking of prior year liabilities from Syndicate 1969 (2017 and prior years) and Syndicate 3330 (2018 year), combined with a prudent reserving policy and reserve strengthening in certain classes.

data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 1994, in its first year of operation (2021), assumed liabilities from Syndicate 1969 (2017 and prior years) and Syndicate 3330 (2018 year) via reinsurance to close (RITC) transactions. This initial booking of prior year liabilities, combined with a prudent reserving policy and a full reserving review of the Syndicate 3330 book, resulted in a gross reserve strengthening of GBP 131.761 million, particularly in non-marine liability construction classes.
raw_causal_phrases: application of a prudent reserving policy
outcome of a full reserving review of the Syndicate 3330 book of business
reserve strengthening in certain classes, in particular non-marine liability construction

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Syndicate 1994 commenced underwriting on 1 January 2021. The 'prior_year_development_gbp_m' represents the initial booking of prior year liabilities assumed via RITC transactions from Syndicate 1969 (2017 and prior years) and Syndicate 3330 (2018 year), combined with reserve strengthening, rather than a movement on existing reserves. 'opening_reserves_gbp_m' is 0 as it is the syndicate's first year of operation.
